auditMetadata.standardText: Repetition passes only when paragraphs, tables, and FAQ do not perform the same role. A failure names both locations and the single existing piece of information to keep.

notSigned.ResearchTrace: Not re-run. D2 historical finding remains bound to the same two hashes and is not re-signed.
notSigned.Length: Not signed. The length script was not re-run. Prior recorded mechanical values are not new evidence and are not a length pass.
notSigned.lengthThresholdException: Still unanswered. Silence is not authorization.

agreementWithD2: v1 RP-1 summary paragraph is absent from v2; 14500g and 32500g remain only in the line 41 calculation.
v1 RP-2 exterior prose sentence is absent from v2 line 55. Same exterior remains as the table cell and the figure label.
v1 RP-3 crib and child-bed list sentence is absent from v2 line 33.
No FAQ and no closing recap module.

The old second-tier price string 50,000g and 150 Hardwood occurs only on line 19. Lines 47, 49, and 53 contain the dining-room price 150,000g, which is a different amount. D2's claim that the old price was not generalized to other sections is true and does not prove the three sentences on line 19 have different roles.
disagreementWithD2: D2 section 6 accepted line 19 as one version note and did not test the three sentences. Sentences 2 and 3 fail.
D2 section 6 did not compare lines 25, 27, 31, and 33 sentence by sentence. This addendum fails 8 sentences there and keeps the sentences listed under retainedSentences.
D2 ResearchTrace correctly records that the v1 write-up sentence is gone. The replacement old-price sentence is still a repetition failure.

issues.issueType: 重复：同一段把 1.6 之前的旧价说了两次
locations: draft-v2.md:19 sentence 3: Before 1.6, that upgrade cost 50,000g and 150 Hardwood
draft-v2.md:19 sentence 1 from-clause: moved from 50,000g and 150 Hardwood
issues.keep: Line 19 sentence 1 already states the pre-1.6 price as the start of the change. The introduction does not state 50,000g or 150 Hardwood.
issues.revisionRequirement: 删除第 19 行第 3 句。不要写回 v1 的 write-up 旁白，也不要另写辨认攻略的新句。

issues.issueType: 重复：版本段把第二档现行价再说成一次带来动作
locations: draft-v2.md:19 sentence 2: When you buy the second upgrade, bring 65,000g and 100 Hardwood.
draft-v2.md:19 sentence 1 to-clause; draft-v2.md:25 second-upgrade carry sentence; table row 2 gold and materials
issues.keep: Sentence 1's to-clause is the end point of the 1.6 change. Table row 2 is the lookup. The hardwood stack distinction stays on line 25 and is not this sentence.
issues.revisionRequirement: 删除第 19 行第 2 句。不要在版本段再写应带金额。

issues.issueType: 重复：第 25 行三句携带金额与表或第 43 行是同一付款作用
locations: draft-v2.md:25: For the first upgrade, carry 10,000g and 450 Wood when that Wood is already yours.
draft-v2.md:25: For the second upgrade, carry 65,000g and 100 Hardwood.
draft-v2.md:25: For the third upgrade, carry 100,000g.
draft-v2.md:43 already-in-chests payment; table row 2; table row 3
issues.keep: Carry one tier at a time. The 100 Hardwood is its own stack and is a separate material from the Wood Robin sells. The already-owned wood payment, including both years looking the same and the shop price staying out, stays on line 43.
issues.revisionRequirement: 删除第 25 行这三句携带金额。留下一次一档，以及 Hardwood 单独成叠。已有木材的 10,000g 付款只留在第 43 行。

issues.issueType: 重复：同一段把普通日 9:00–17:00 和关门后仍能进门各说了两次
locations: draft-v2.md:27: On the other ordinary days, place it between 9:00am and 5:00pm.
draft-v2.md:27: After the counter has closed, and until 8:00pm, the door still opens.
draft-v2.md:27 sentence 1 ordinary 9:00am to 5:00pm; draft-v2.md:27 house entry 9:00am to 8:00pm while the shop is closed
issues.keep: Ordinary counter baseline, Tuesday closed, Friday 4:00pm, house entry until 8:00pm while the shop is closed, and the upgrade waiting until the counter is open again.
issues.revisionRequirement: 删除这两句。不要把同一钟点或同一进门窗口再写一遍。

issues.issueType: 重复：三天段复述表内完工内容，并在对比完成后把三天再说一遍
locations: draft-v2.md:31: The kitchen, the added rooms, or the cellar from that payment is in the house after those three days.
draft-v2.md:31: A farmhouse upgrade stays on three days.
table Added column and Days column; draft-v2.md:31 sentence 1 and the sentence assigning the two-day clock to other buildings
issues.keep: Every farmhouse upgrade takes three days. Most other construction finishes in two days at the start of the second day. That two-day finish is the clock for those other buildings.
issues.revisionRequirement: 删除第 31 行这两句。不要换词把三天或三样房间再写回来。

issues.issueType: 重复：吊坠句复述表内施工完成条件和三天等待
locations: draft-v2.md:33: The Mermaid's Pendant needs the first upgrade's construction finished, so the pendant comes after that three-day build.
table row 1 pendant cell: needs completed construction on this upgrade; line 33 sentences 1 and 2
issues.keep: The table already separates the pendant from mere payment by requiring completed construction. Line 33's first two sentences keep the payment-to-finished interval and the unfinished payment day.
issues.revisionRequirement: 删除第 33 行这句吊坠时序。不要在三天段重讲表内吊坠条件。
